# Test R3 - comparison behavior
import importlib
import semver
importlib.reload(semver)

v = semver.VersionInfo(1, 2, 3)

# Should work with tuples
print("v == (1,2,3):", v == (1, 2, 3))
print("v == (1,2,4):", v == (1, 2, 4))
print("v < (1,2,4):", v < (1, 2, 4))
print("v > (1,2,2):", v > (1, 2, 2))

# Should raise TypeError with strings and integers
for other in ["1.2.3", "abc", 42]:
    try:
        result = v == other
        print(f"v == {other!r}: returned {result} (BAD - should raise)")
    except TypeError as e:
        print(f"v == {other!r}: raised TypeError (GOOD)")
    
    try:
        result = v != other
        print(f"v != {other!r}: returned {result} (BAD - should raise)")
    except TypeError as e:
        print(f"v != {other!r}: raised TypeError (GOOD)")
